sources.label: Wikipedia, "Nu2 Sagittarii"
sources.quote: Nu2 Sagittarii (ν2 Sagittarii), also named Pabilsang, is a binary star system in the zodiac constellation of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 113 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,186 K, so 20.202 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Nu2 Sagittarii"
sources.quote: It is faintly visible to the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of +4.98; it is 0.16 degree north of the ecliptic.
